children: Piper Sandler maintained their Neutral rating on Investar Holding's stock with a price target of $31.00.
The price target implies an upside of 11.4% from the Oct 26 close of $27.82.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Despite a positive trajectory driven by the closure of the WFB deal, Investar Holding experienced weaker-than-expected loan growth in the third quarter, primarily due to the planned run-off of some WFB loans. This decline in average loans and assets under management has led to lowered estimates for future earnings.

: The bank's net interest margin (NIM) showed a slight expansion, and management has demonstrated strong discipline in controlling operating expenses. This stability in NIM, coupled with disciplined expense management, provides a balanced outlook, contributing to the decision to maintain a Neutral rating.
